en.bdb: Himself the enjoyer as well as the joy

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਲੰਘੁ ਵਿਛਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਉਂਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: aape pala(n)gh vichhai kai aap a(n)dhar sau(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: He Himself spreads the bedstead and Himself reclines on it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਉਂਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: suhane a(n)dhar jai kai dhesa(n)tar bhau(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Entering into the dreams, He wanders through far off regions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਕੁ ਰਾਉ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਉਂਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)k raau raau ra(n)k hoi dhukh sukh vich pau(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Making the poor a king and the king a poor person He puts them in pain and pleasure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਤਾ ਸੀਅਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਲੁ ਆਵਟਣੁ ਖਉਂਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: tataa seearaa hoi jal aavaTan khau(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: In the form of water He Himself gets hot and cold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਾਂਵਦਾ ਚਾਵਾਏ ਚਉਂਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: harakh sog vich dhaa(n)vadhaa chaavaae chau(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Amidst sorrows and delights, He moves around and responds to the call when called.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਉਂਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh rau(n)dhaa ||4||

en.bdb: The gurmukh, realising  His nature of premeating through all, attains happiness.
